flawed_step: 0003: The assertion that the remaining subgraph must contain at least |C|+1 connected components is false. It has n-|C| vertices and n-1-|C|=(n-|C|)-1 edges, which only guarantees at least one component.
counterexample: For n=5 and |C|=3, the remaining subgraph has 2 vertices and 1 edge; it can be connected, so it need not have |C|+1=4 components.
assessment_summary: The first attempted direction contains a definite false component-count claim, so verification stops at step 0003.
